_readme: Copy this to `.g2-agent-cron.json` in web/ (or point AGENT_CRON_FILE at it) to give
the fleet a clock. Nothing runs until a file like this exists AND enabled is true.
Times are HH:MM in timeZone, never UTC — Railway runs in UTC, so a schedule without
a zone would fire eight hours early for Singapore.
days is 0=Sunday..6=Saturday; omit it for every day.
The agent must ALREADY exist on the hub, by name. A job never creates or edits one.
graceMinutes lets a host that was asleep still run a slot it woke up late for;
outside that window the slot is missed and said so in the log.
Set G2_AGENT_CRON=0 in the environment to turn the clock off without touching this file.
